title: 第4152章 双生感应 文明善恶初判第4151章 星舰新程 未知文明来讯
slug: 签到玄天我成了万界守护者
content_zh:
方浩走出主控室，脚步没停。走廊的灯一盏接一盏亮起来，像是被他踩着地砖的脚步声叫醒的。他袖子里那张接待物资清单已经翻来覆去看了三遍，灵网通告发了，阵法调试也派了人盯，连迎宾茶该用几片老山参都记在小本上——玄天宗讲礼数，哪怕接个外星客人也不能塌了门面。
他拐进侧翼静室，门刚滑开一条缝，就听见里头“喵嗷——”一声炸响。
不是普通的猫叫，是那种从嗓子眼直接撕出来的哭嚎，听着像谁把锅底灰抹进了耳朵里。方浩眉头一跳，抬手冲身后摆了摆，还没来得及说话，跟过来的两名执事弟子就自觉退后三步，背靠墙站成两尊门神。
“又来了。”他嘀咕一句，走进去顺手关门。
静室不大，中央摆着个软垫，上面躺着两只通体漆黑的小猫，正是黑焱不知哪天打盹时分裂出来的双生子。平日里懒得出油，喂食不睁眼，连楚轻狂拿蛟龙肉干逗它们都懒得甩尾巴。可现在这两家伙缩成两团毛球，浑身打颤，耳朵贴头，瞳孔忽明忽暗，黑白交错得像是被人往眼里灌了墨水又倒点银粉搅了搅。
“吵死了。”方浩低声骂了一句，走过去蹲下，“谁给你们吃变质灵米了？还是陆小舟又拿变异白菜喷雾练手？”
话音未落，两猫齐齐抬头，冲着他张嘴就是一串高频啼哭，声音不大但钻脑门，仿佛有根细针顺着耳道往颅内凿。
方浩立刻闭嘴，伸手按住太阳穴揉了两下。他盯着那对诡异的眼睛，忽然反应过来：“你们……感应到什么了？”
两只猫不答话，当然也不会答，只是抖得更厉害了，其中一只爪子无意识在地上划拉，竟勾出一道歪歪扭扭的弧线，像极了星舰外那条未知文明信号的波形轨迹。
“行吧。”方浩叹了口气，盘腿坐下，“不哭了啊，再哭我把你俩塞进鼎里炖汤，就说新菜谱叫‘阴阳哭丧羹’。”
他把手轻轻覆在两只猫头顶，闭眼默念《玄灵感应诀》口诀。这功法不算高深，早年签到得过一本残卷，原以为只能拿来哄徒弟入定，没想到今天派上这用场。
神识缓缓下沉，与那股躁动波动对接的一瞬，眼前猛地闪出一片光影——
先是银蓝色的光晕，缓慢流淌，安静有序，像是春日湖面被风吹皱的倒影，带着一股温和的秩序感，不压迫，也不张扬。
可就在他稍稍放松时，一道猩红丝线突然穿插而过，快得几乎抓不住，却留下一股黏腻的错觉，像有人偷偷在糖水里掺了血。
画面断了。
他又试了一次，结果一样：蓝光稳定持续，红丝一闪即逝，再想捕捉，脑仁就开始胀痛。
方浩收回手，睁开眼，脸色有点沉。
“一半清粥，一半毒药？”他喃喃道，“还混得挺匀。”
两只猫瘫在垫子上喘气，眼泪汪汪，一副耗尽元气的模样。刚才那一通哭，怕是把能感知的东西全吼出来了。
方浩站起身，在屋里来回踱步。脚步不重，但每一步都踩得结实。

“请都请了，总不能临时改口说今日不宜待客。”他自言自语，“可要是客人进门递的是笑脸，袖子里藏的是刀，咱也不能光捧茶。”
他走到墙边控制台前，调出防御阵图备份。原计划在舰首布置三十六盏引路灯，营造暖光迎宾氛围，现在手指一点，全改成镇压节点，位置微调七寸，符纹嵌入底层阵基，表面看仍是装饰，实则暗藏反制禁制。
他又顺手在通讯频道加了道监听咒印，万一那边开口说的是和平，放出来的是杀招，至少能抢半息反应时间。
做完这些，他回头看了眼仍在昏睡的双生子，低声说：“你们这一哭，倒是比那些算吉时、看星象的靠谱多了。”
他整了整衣袖，转身朝门外走。临出门前，指尖在袖中轻轻一掐，一道隐秘符印悄然成型，贴于掌心，随时可激活。
走廊灯光依旧明亮，映着他笔直的身影一步步远去。静室内，余温未散，两只黑猫蜷在软垫上，鼻尖微微抽动，仿佛还在梦里听见那缕猩红气息，悄悄游走。

content_en:
Fang Hao walked out of the main control room without stopping. The lights in the corridor turned on one after another, as if they were awakened by his footsteps on the floor tiles. He has gone through the list of reception supplies in his sleeve three times. The spirit network notice has been announced, and people have been sent to monitor the formation debugging. Even the number of slices of old wild ginseng that should be used for the welcome tea is recorded in the notebook - the Xuantian Sect is very polite, and the facade cannot be ruined even if it accepts an alien guest.
He turned into the quiet room in the wing, and as soon as the door slid open a crack, he heard an explosion from inside.
It wasn't an ordinary meow, it was the kind of cry that was ripped straight out of the throat, and it sounded like someone had put ashes from the bottom of a pot into their ears. Fang Hao's brows jumped, and he raised his hand and waved it behind him. Before he could speak, the two deacon disciples who followed him took three steps back and stood with their backs against the wall, forming two door gods.
"Here we go again." He muttered, walked in and closed the door.
The quiet room was not big, and there was a soft cushion in the center, with two black kittens lying on it. They were the twins that separated from each other when Hei Yan was taking a nap one day. On weekdays, he was too lazy to draw oil, and would not open his eyes when feeding. Even Chu Qingkuang was too lazy to flick his tail to tease them with dragon meat jerky. But now these two guys were curled up into two balls of hair, trembling all over, their ears pressed against their heads, their pupils flickering on and off, black and white intertwined as if someone had poured ink into their eyes and stirred them up with some silver powder.
"It's so noisy." Fang Hao cursed in a low voice, walked over and squatted down, "Who gave you the spoiled spiritual rice? Or is Lu Xiaozhou practicing with the mutant cabbage spray again?"
Before he finished speaking, the two cats raised their heads at the same time, opened their mouths at him and let out a series of high-frequency cries. The sound was not loud, but it penetrated the forehead, as if a thin needle was digging into the skull along the ear canal.
Fang Hao immediately shut up, reached out and pressed his temples and rubbed them twice. He stared at those strange eyes and suddenly reacted: "You... sensed something?"
The two cats didn't answer, and of course they wouldn't. They just trembled more violently. One of their paws unconsciously scratched the ground, drawing a crooked arc, which was very similar to the waveform trajectory of the unknown civilization's signal outside the starship.
"Okay." Fang Hao sighed and sat down cross-legged, "Stop crying. If you cry again, I'll stuff you two into a cauldron and stew soup. I'll call the new recipe 'Yin Yang Crying Mourning Soup'."
He gently placed his hands on the heads of the two cats, closed his eyes and silently recited the "Mysterious Soul Induction Technique". This technique is not very advanced. In the early years, I got a fragment of the scroll when I signed in. I thought it could only be used to coax the apprentice into meditation, but I didn't expect it to be used today.
His consciousness slowly sank, and the moment he connected with the restless fluctuations, a piece of light suddenly flashed before his eyes——
First there was a silver-blue halo, flowing slowly, quietly and orderly, like the reflection of a lake ruffled by the wind in spring, with a gentle sense of order, neither oppressive nor ostentatious.
But just when he relaxed a little, a scarlet thread suddenly passed through it. It was so fast that it was almost impossible to catch, but it left a sticky illusion, as if someone had secretly mixed blood in the sugar water.
The screen is cut off.
He tried again, but the result was the same: the blue light continued steadily, the red thread flickered, and when he tried to catch it again, his brain began to swell and hurt.
Fang Hao retracted his hand and opened his eyes, his face a little gloomy.
"Half porridge, half poison?" He murmured, "It's evenly mixed."
The two cats were slumped on the mat, panting, with tears in their eyes, looking exhausted. The crying just now probably caused me to shout out all the things I could perceive.
Fang Hao stood up and paced back and forth in the room. The steps are not heavy, but each step is firm.
"I've already invited you, but we can't change our words and say today is not a good time to entertain guests." He said to himself, "But if a guest comes in with a smile and a knife hidden in his sleeve, we can't just hold tea."
He walked to the console on the wall and called up the defense map backup. The original plan was to arrange thirty-six guiding lights at the bow of the ship to create a warm welcome atmosphere. Now, with a click of a finger, they were all changed into suppression nodes. The position was slightly adjusted by seven inches, and the rune patterns were embedded in the underlying array.Base, on the surface it is still a decoration, but in fact it is a hidden counter-restriction.
He also conveniently added a listening curse seal to the communication channel. If the person on the other end spoke of peace and unleashed a killing move, at least half of the reaction time would be lost.
After doing this, he looked back at the twins who were still sleeping, and whispered: "Your crying is much more reliable than those who tell auspicious times and read the stars."
He straightened his sleeves, turned around and walked out the door. Before leaving the house, he lightly pinched his sleeve with his fingertips, and a secret talisman quietly took shape and stuck to his palm, ready to be activated at any time.
The lights in the corridor were still bright, reflecting his straight figure walking away step by step. In the quiet room, the lingering warmth had not dissipated. Two black cats were curled up on the soft cushions, their noses twitching slightly, as if they were still hearing the scarlet breath quietly wandering away in their dreams.
